name: @shop-plus/reseller-money
description: MONEY-SHAPE-1 — the reseller-margin arithmetic and the markup CEILING, in ONE place imported by both the reseller app (which displays the numbers) and storefront-service (which SIGNS them). A service that signs must bound; the rule bounding that money may not live only in the app whose authority over money was removed. Dependency-free, so the RN bundle can carry it.
